text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I was suddenly summoned to the 
director's office. Wearing my nerves on my 
sleeve, wondering what on earth I could 
have done wrong—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To my surprise, Chairwoman Akikawa herself 
offered words of praise!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems <chrname>'s performance over the past year 
was thoroughly satisfying in Chairwoman 
Akikawa's eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Savoring the joy, they renewed their 
determination to keep giving it their all 
together!
